## How to test

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
- [ ] Works in demo mode (no `GEMINI_API_KEY`)

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No new personal data stored
- [ ] New inputs validated with zod and length-capped
- [ ] Staff-only routes still require the PIN
